planPhases.title: Replace inline filter/sort logic in App.tsx with filterProducts() call
planPhases.notes: App.tsx imports filterProducts from productFilters.ts but never calls it. Instead, visibleProducts useMemo re-implements identical filter+sort logic inline (lines 19–44 of src/App.tsx). Fix: replace the entire useMemo body with `filterProducts(products, filters)` so it reads: `const visibleProducts = useMemo(() => filterProducts(products, filters), [products, filters]);`. This removes the inline duplication and satisfies the separation-of-concerns requirement.

planPhases.title: Remove normalizeSearch dead code from productFilters.ts
planPhases.notes: productFilters.ts exports a `normalizeSearch` function (lines 10–13) with a comment that it was from early development and never cleaned up. Grep confirms it is unused everywhere in the codebase. Remove the function and its comment entirely.

planPhases.title: Export defaultFilters from productFilters.ts and use it in FilterPanel.tsx
planPhases.notes: Added `export const defaultFilters: FilterState` to productFilters.ts. Updated FilterPanel.tsx to import `defaultFilters` and use `onChange(defaultFilters)` in handleClear instead of the inline literal. All 17 tests pass.

planPhases.notes: All 17 tests pass across 6 test files. Build also succeeds (tsc + vite). No regressions introduced by any prior phase.
